summary: Initialized repository for spec-driven development. Created root structure, README, .gitignore, LICENSE.
Authored requirements.md, architecture.md, data-model.md, api-contract.md, state-machine.md, ui-flow.md, test-strategy.md.
Created implementation-plan.md with 21 phases. Added rules/, commands/, skills/ AI guidance artifacts.
Backend bootstrap: Spring Boot 3.3.5, Java 21, Flyway, PostgreSQL. Domain model and repositories.
Ticket state machine: TicketStateTransitions allow-list, TicketStateTransitionValidator, 5 valid transitions.
REST APIs: create, retrieve, update, status transition, comments, search/filter. All at /api/v1/tickets.
Backend integration and acceptance tests with Testcontainers PostgreSQL. SupportTicketBackendAcceptanceTest.
Frontend bootstrap: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, configurable VITE_API_BASE_URL.
Frontend UI: ticket list, create, details/edit, comments, status transition actions.
Playwright E2E: primary workflow, search/filter, validation, negative transitions, persistence.
Full-stack Docker: frontend nginx container, compose orchestration, verify script.
AI and human review completed. Fixed Docker healthcheck timing. Updated traceability and acceptance checklists.
